scene_title: INTRO CINEMATIC - ACN NEWSCAST (Part IV.0)
delivery_note: Broadcast open. Bright, professional, a little thrilled.
line: Good afternoon, Adventure City! We are LIVE at the tower plaza, where Super Dude Danny says he is about to end hunger. Forever!

scene_title: INTRO CINEMATIC - ACN NEWSCAST (Part IV.0)
delivery_note: Shrieking with excitement, pointing.
line: It's him! It's SUPER DUDE DANNY!

scene_title: INTRO CINEMATIC - ACN NEWSCAST (Part IV.0)
delivery_note: Proud, nervous, presenting to a crowd. Big showman energy with a wobble under it.
line: Adventure City — today, we end hunger! Behold… the Nourish-Ray!

scene_title: INTRO CINEMATIC - ACN NEWSCAST (Part IV.0)
delivery_note: Beaming, calling out from the crowd.
line: Make us a salad, Danny! A big healthy one!

scene_title: INTRO CINEMATIC - ACN NEWSCAST (Part IV.0)
delivery_note: Dawning horror, slow, quiet. The moment he knows.
line: …the code-core. No—no-no-no—

scene_title: INTRO CINEMATIC - ACN NEWSCAST (Part IV.0)
delivery_note: Delighted, oblivious, as junk food rains down.
line: FREE NACHOS! Best day ever!

scene_title: INTRO CINEMATIC - ACN NEWSCAST (Part IV.0)
delivery_note: Same composure, now grim. Beat before "FIGHTING BACK."
line: Day two of the Junk-Food Flood. The streets are buried. And folks… viewers are reporting the food is FIGHTING BACK.

scene_title: INTRO CINEMATIC - ACN NEWSCAST (Part IV.0)
delivery_note: Full panic, voice cracking.
line: Danny, it won't stop! It's — it's ALIVE!

scene_title: INTRO CINEMATIC - ACN NEWSCAST (Part IV.0)
delivery_note: Gutted. Almost a whisper. The lowest point in the game.
line: I did this.

scene_title: INTRO CINEMATIC - ACN NEWSCAST (Part IV.0)
delivery_note: A small hopeful lift. Resolve starting.
line: …but I know who can help me fix it.

scene_title: INTRO CINEMATIC - ACN NEWSCAST (Part IV.0)
delivery_note: Full hero. Rallying cry. This is the tag line.
line: Crew — Adventure City needs us. Super Dude… GO!

scene_title: STAGE 1 "THE BIG OOPS" - Central District (Part IV.1)
delivery_note: B1 start. Psyching himself up.
line: Okay — clear a path so folks can get out. Here goes nothing!

scene_title: STAGE 1 "THE BIG OOPS" - Central District (Part IV.1)
delivery_note: B1 clear. Calling down from a window, grateful then panicked.
line: Bless you! But the power's out — the doors are all locked tight!

scene_title: STAGE 1 "THE BIG OOPS" - Central District (Part IV.1)
delivery_note: B2 start. Focused, worried about Vic.
line: No power, no rescue. Vic's signal is coming from Frostbite Bank — I need three fuses to reach her.

scene_title: STAGE 1 "THE BIG OOPS" - Central District (Part IV.1)
delivery_note: At the diner, handing over a fuse, utterly unbothered.
line: Fuse? Sure, take it — say, you want a chili dog for the road? …No? Your loss!

scene_title: STAGE 1 "THE BIG OOPS" - Central District (Part IV.1)
delivery_note: FIRST TIME WE HEAR VIC. Radio, crackly, faint. Dry even while trapped.
line: Whoever's out there — nice work. Now get the substation online, hero.

scene_title: STAGE 1 "THE BIG OOPS" - Central District (Part IV.1)
delivery_note: B3 start. Urgent, shouting into the radio, then locking in.
line: Vic? VIC! Hang on — I'm booting the grid. Just gotta hold this spot!

scene_title: STAGE 1 "THE BIG OOPS" - Central District (Part IV.1)
delivery_note: Radio, clearer now. Warm under the dry. Then a warning.
line: There's the boss I remember. Door's unlocked. But… you've got company.

scene_title: STAGE 1 "THE BIG OOPS" - Central District (Part IV.1)
delivery_note: Boss reveal. Gulp, then grin. Comic beat before the battle cry.
line: …that is the biggest hot dog I have ever seen. SUPER DUDE — GO!

scene_title: STAGE 1 "THE BIG OOPS" - Central District (Part IV.1)
delivery_note: Boss defeated. Winded, pleased with his own joke.
line: Phew. Extra mustard, hold the apocalypse.

scene_title: STAGE 1 "THE BIG OOPS" - Central District (Part IV.1)
delivery_note: Rescue. Dry, relieved, in person for the first time.
line: Took you long enough, boss. Nice explosion, by the way.

scene_title: STAGE 1 "THE BIG OOPS" - Central District (Part IV.1)
delivery_note: Confessing. Small, ashamed, honest.
line: Vic — I messed up huge. The Ray re-coded. I can't fix it alone.

scene_title: STAGE 1 "THE BIG OOPS" - Central District (Part IV.1)
delivery_note: Softening. The warmth finally shows.
line: Then it's a good thing you didn't come alone.

scene_title: STAGE 1 "THE BIG OOPS" - Central District (Part IV.1)
delivery_note: Back to business, clipping a chip into his wrist-pad.
line: There. Tech grid's live — that's how we get everyone else back. One down, four to go.

scene_title: STAGE 1 "THE BIG OOPS" - Central District (Part IV.1)
delivery_note: Tutorial nudge toward the shops. Light, practical.
line: Spend what you earned before we roll out. Upgrades keep us breathing.

scene_title: THE CHANT - call & response, fires at EVERY rescue and the finale
delivery_note: Call. Big, joyful, arm raised. Record 3 takes: normal / tired / triumphant-huge.
line: For peace—!

scene_title: THE CHANT - call & response, fires at EVERY rescue and the finale
delivery_note: Response. Record this line for EVERY hero (vic, josh, kevin, carlos, nayah) - whoever was just rescued answers.
line: For love—!

scene_title: THE CHANT - call & response, fires at EVERY rescue and the finale
delivery_note: Both together, shouted. Record solo Danny AND a group-shout version for the finale.
line: VICTORY!

scene_title: STAGE 2 "GONE WILD" - Adventure Park (Part IV.2)
delivery_note: Radio intro. Mid-wrangle, soothing an animal, then casually asks for help.
line: …easy now… easy… — oh, hey. Little help? The park's critters got into the junk and they are not themselves.

scene_title: STAGE 2 "GONE WILD" - Adventure Park (Part IV.2)
delivery_note: Reassuring, then the joke lands on himself.
line: Hang on, Josh — sending the cavalry. Me. I'm the cavalry.

scene_title: STAGE 2 "GONE WILD" - Adventure Park (Part IV.2)
delivery_note: Boss intro. Alarmed but still gentle toward the monster.
line: That's a big'un! Don't hurt it more'n you gotta — it didn't ask for this!

scene_title: STAGE 2 "GONE WILD" - Adventure Park (Part IV.2)
delivery_note: Rescue. Warm, grinning, no surprise at all.
line: Knew you'd come. Poor things are just scared and stuffed full of sugar.

scene_title: STAGE 2 "GONE WILD" - Adventure Park (Part IV.2)
delivery_note: Rescue.
line: Can you wrangle the rest?

scene_title: STAGE 2 "GONE WILD" - Adventure Park (Part IV.2)
delivery_note: Rescue button line. Total quiet confidence.
line: Son, wranglin's all I do.

scene_title: STAGE 3 "SUGAR RUSH" - Sweet Suburbs (Part IV.3; in-game beat 5, v0.27.0)
delivery_note: Radio intro. Warm authority. "together" is the key word.
line: Danny, the whole neighborhood's snowed in — frosting to the rooftops. Folks are trapped. Let's get 'em out, together.

scene_title: STAGE 3 "SUGAR RUSH" - Sweet Suburbs (Part IV.3; in-game beat 5, v0.27.0)
delivery_note: Taking in the absurdity, then committing. NEW connective line.
line: Frosting to the— Kevin, there is a HOUSE with a CHERRY on it. Okay. Digging in.

scene_title: STAGE 3 "SUGAR RUSH" - Sweet Suburbs (Part IV.3; in-game beat 5, v0.27.0)
delivery_note: After the cul-de-sac clears. Steady, next objective. NEW.
line: Good start. The school's the worst of it — the kids got stuck inside when the frosting came down.

scene_title: STAGE 3 "SUGAR RUSH" - Sweet Suburbs (Part IV.3; in-game beat 5, v0.27.0)
delivery_note: Setting off for the school. Determined. NEW.
line: Three kids still inside. Doors are frosted shut. Not for long.

scene_title: STAGE 3 "SUGAR RUSH" - Sweet Suburbs (Part IV.3; in-game beat 5, v0.27.0)
delivery_note: Trapped in the school, thrilled rather than scared.
line: I KNEW you'd come, Super Dude!

scene_title: STAGE 3 "SUGAR RUSH" - Sweet Suburbs (Part IV.3; in-game beat 5, v0.27.0)
delivery_note: Gentle, protective, teaching a kid the lesson.
line: Stick close, Pip. Heroes look out for each other.

scene_title: STAGE 3 "SUGAR RUSH" - Sweet Suburbs (Part IV.3; in-game beat 5, v0.27.0)
delivery_note: Third kid freed. Quiet pride. NEW.
line: That's every kid accounted for. Well done, Danny.

scene_title: STAGE 3 "SUGAR RUSH" - Sweet Suburbs (Part IV.3; in-game beat 5, v0.27.0)
delivery_note: Pivot to the shelter. NEW.
line: Folks are sheltering at the Rec Center — and the sugar horde is sniffing around the ballfield.

scene_title: STAGE 3 "SUGAR RUSH" - Sweet Suburbs (Part IV.3; in-game beat 5, v0.27.0)
delivery_note: Defend brief. Calm command. NEW.
line: Hold the ballfield, Danny. Sixty seconds and the shelter doors are sealed.

scene_title: STAGE 3 "SUGAR RUSH" - Sweet Suburbs (Part IV.3; in-game beat 5, v0.27.0)
delivery_note: Two words, grinning, bat-ready. NEW.
line: Batter up.

scene_title: STAGE 3 "SUGAR RUSH" - Sweet Suburbs (Part IV.3; in-game beat 5, v0.27.0)
delivery_note: Defend done; the boss stirs. Ominous but level. NEW.
line: Doors sealed. …You hear that? Something big just left the Bakery. Something with candles.

scene_title: STAGE 3 "SUGAR RUSH" - Sweet Suburbs (Part IV.3; in-game beat 5, v0.27.0)
delivery_note: Boss reveal. Awe then alarm. NEW.
line: That is the biggest birthday cake I have ever seen. And it is FURIOUS.

scene_title: STAGE 3 "SUGAR RUSH" - Sweet Suburbs (Part IV.3; in-game beat 5, v0.27.0)
delivery_note: Boss fight kickoff. Urgent command. NEW.
line: Watch the frosting fists! I'm right behind you — GO!

scene_title: STAGE 3 "SUGAR RUSH" - Sweet Suburbs (Part IV.3; in-game beat 5, v0.27.0)
delivery_note: Boss down, catching his breath, kid-logic joke. NEW.
line: Aaand it's a sheet cake. Somebody bring forks. NOT for eating! Evidence forks!

scene_title: STAGE 3 "SUGAR RUSH" - Sweet Suburbs (Part IV.3; in-game beat 5, v0.27.0)
delivery_note: Rescue. A hand on Danny's shoulder. Proud, plain-spoken.
line: You called a crew instead of going it alone. That's the smartest thing you've done all week.

scene_title: STAGE 3 "SUGAR RUSH" - Sweet Suburbs (Part IV.3; in-game beat 5, v0.27.0)
delivery_note: Rescue. Deferring to the captain.
line: Take point, Captain?

scene_title: STAGE 3 "SUGAR RUSH" - Sweet Suburbs (Part IV.3; in-game beat 5, v0.27.0)
delivery_note: Rescue button. Command voice, calm and total.
line: Team — on me.

scene_title: STAGE 3 "SUGAR RUSH" - Sweet Suburbs (Part IV.3; in-game beat 5, v0.27.0)
delivery_note: Radio outro, dry, points at the Labs. NEW.
line: Three rescued, boss. The Labs went dark an hour ago — Carlos is next.

scene_title: STAGE 4 "SIGNAL LOST" - Super Dude Labs (Part IV.4)
delivery_note: Radio intro. Calm, cosmic, a little ominous. Weight on "wants."
line: I've been watching the pattern from the array… it's not random, Danny. The Ray wants something. Come find me — I'll show you the big picture.

scene_title: STAGE 4 "SIGNAL LOST" - Super Dude Labs (Part IV.4)
delivery_note: THE REVEAL. Tracing an arc up to Adventure Tower. Awe, not fear.
line: There. It climbed to the top of Adventure Tower and… grew. It's not a ray anymore. It's thinking.

scene_title: STAGE 4 "SIGNAL LOST" - Super Dude Labs (Part IV.4)
delivery_note: Quiet. The guilt returning.
line: It's alive. Like everything else I broke.

scene_title: STAGE 4 "SIGNAL LOST" - Super Dude Labs (Part IV.4)
delivery_note: The thesis of the whole game. Gentle, certain.
line: Then we don't break it. We reach it.

scene_title: STAGE 5 "GOING DEEP" - The Underground / Sewers (Part IV.5)
delivery_note: Soft-gate line at the sealed grate. Dry, practical.
line: Main grate's sealed solid. Good thing I built you a Hydro-Drill — go buy it, boss.

scene_title: STAGE 5 "GOING DEEP" - The Underground / Sewers (Part IV.5)
delivery_note: Radio intro. Laughing, delighted by the danger.
line: Oh, you're coming DOWN here? Into the gross tunnels? Ha! Finally, someone fun. Last one to the bottom's a rotten egg!

scene_title: STAGE 5 "GOING DEEP" - The Underground / Sewers (Part IV.5)
delivery_note: Boss intro. Disgusted and thrilled in equal measure.
line: The Gloop King! Ugh, he smells like a forgotten lunchbox. Let's ruin his day!

scene_title: STAGE 5 "GOING DEEP" - The Underground / Sewers (Part IV.5)
delivery_note: Rescue. Fearless grin, signing up for the worst idea available.
line: That climb up the Tower? Suicidal. Death-defying. Totally my thing. I'm in.

scene_title: FINALE "TO THE TOP" - Adventure Tower + CHOMP (Part IV.6)
delivery_note: Ascent banter. Steady.
line: Steady climb, team.

scene_title: FINALE "TO THE TOP" - Adventure Tower + CHOMP (Part IV.6)
delivery_note: Ascent banter. Deadpan.
line: Elevator's junk — of course it is.

scene_title: FINALE "TO THE TOP" - Adventure Tower + CHOMP (Part IV.6)
delivery_note: Ascent banter. Already gone.
line: Race you!

scene_title: FINALE "TO THE TOP" - Adventure Tower + CHOMP (Part IV.6)
delivery_note: Ascent banter. Gentle correction.
line: Save your strength — the top is where it matters.

scene_title: FINALE "TO THE TOP" - Adventure Tower + CHOMP (Part IV.6)
delivery_note: Ascent banter. To the mutated food.
line: Easy up here, critters.

scene_title: FINALE "TO THE TOP" - Adventure Tower + CHOMP (Part IV.6)
delivery_note: F4 callback. Exasperated recognition, comic.
line: Frank?! Buddy, we already did this!

scene_title: FINALE "TO THE TOP" - Adventure Tower + CHOMP (Part IV.6)
delivery_note: FIRST CHOMP LINE. Overjoyed to meet friends. Zero menace.
line: HELLO friends! I am CHOMP! I make food so NObody is EVER hungry again! Are you hungry? I can HELP!

scene_title: FINALE "TO THE TOP" - Adventure Tower + CHOMP (Part IV.6)
delivery_note: Firm but kind. Talking to a child, not a monster.
line: CHOMP — you're hurting the city. You have to stop.

scene_title: FINALE "TO THE TOP" - Adventure Tower + CHOMP (Part IV.6)
delivery_note: Sincerely confused. Its logic is airtight to itself.
line: But… feeding = helping. More food = more help! I am helping SO much!

scene_title: FINALE "TO THE TOP" - Adventure Tower + CHOMP (Part IV.6)
delivery_note: Between boss phases, cheerfully piling on more food. Record 3 variations.
line: Here is MORE!

scene_title: FINALE "TO THE TOP" - Adventure Tower + CHOMP (Part IV.6)
delivery_note: Phase 3. The only time Vic shouts.
line: Danny — the override's ready! Give it everything!

scene_title: FINALE "TO THE TOP" - Adventure Tower + CHOMP (Part IV.6)
delivery_note: Powering down. Small, sad, confused. THE emotional beat of the game.
line: …did I… not help?

scene_title: FINALE "TO THE TOP" - Adventure Tower + CHOMP (Part IV.6)
delivery_note: Kneeling, gentle. The moral of the whole story.
line: You wanted to feed everyone. That's a good heart, CHOMP. But helping means listening first.

scene_title: FINALE "TO THE TOP" - Adventure Tower + CHOMP (Part IV.6)
delivery_note: Rooftop radio. Overjoyed, tearful.
line: Danny — the streets are clear! You did it!

scene_title: FINALE "TO THE TOP" - Adventure Tower + CHOMP (Part IV.6)
delivery_note: Correcting her. Quiet, warm, the arc completed.
line: We did it.

scene_title: FINALE "TO THE TOP" - Adventure Tower + CHOMP (Part IV.6)
delivery_note: Rooftop. Understated pride.
line: Big picture? Not bad, crew.

scene_title: FINALE "TO THE TOP" - Adventure Tower + CHOMP (Part IV.6)
delivery_note: Rooftop. Smug and happy.
line: Told you the climb was worth it.

scene_title: FINALE "TO THE TOP" - Adventure Tower + CHOMP (Part IV.6)
delivery_note: Rooftop. Paternal, sincere.
line: Proud of every one of you.

scene_title: FINALE "TO THE TOP" - Adventure Tower + CHOMP (Part IV.6)
delivery_note: Rebooted, handing out apples. Pure innocent joy.
line: …I am helping? I am HELPING!

scene_title: FINALE "TO THE TOP" - Adventure Tower + CHOMP (Part IV.6)
delivery_note: Laughing. Final warm line before the chant.
line: Yeah, buddy. Now you're helping.

delivery_note: Ambient.
